notes: Moved Groq title normalization off the Qt GUI thread into a background worker, eliminating the 10-20 second UI freeze/Windows ghost window when Groq is slow or times out.
Added a conservative local fallback that extracts an obvious English title from mixed Romaji (English Title) names; the reported Insipid Prince title now resolves correctly even when Groq fails.
Cached Groq model selection for the running process to avoid repeating the models API lookup for every title.
